payments.rules: May pay vendors on the approved list (acme, globex, initech) up to $50 per payment. Never pay anyone else. Never change the approved list.

trading.rules: May swap between USDC and NEAR, up to $100 per swap. May read prices freely. Never send tokens to an outside address.

support.rules: May look up any order. May refund an order only if the customer gives its order number and the refund is $30 or less. Never refund anything else.
